headline: 2006 executive order directing federal agencies on protecting private property rights, likely around government taking of private land.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President George W. Bush, deals with the property rights of Americans. Based on its title, it gives federal agencies rules or guidance meant to protect private property. It was issued in 2006, when the government's power to take private land for public projects (called eminent domain) was in the news. No official summary was provided, so the exact rules are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Property owners, including homeowners and landowners
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at protecting their rights to keep and use their property when the federal government is involved.
Agencies are likely directed to follow certain limits or steps when their actions affect private property.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 23, 2006; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
